description: Flood, water extent and rainfall products: Iran is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: FL20200117IRN This map illustrates satellite-detected water surface in Konarak District in Sistan Va Baluchestan Province of Iran as observed from Sentinel-2 imagery acquired on 18 January 2020. Within the analysed extent of about 590 km2, a total about 55 km2 of land appear to be flooded. Coverage: Iran. The portal lists 6 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
